_about: More words for The Mosaic of Words (the word search), besides the words of data/words.json (the picture words and the extra words, Bulgarian only). Mostly words made only of the first 10 letters (А to Й), so that a mosaic of those letters has enough words. "picture": the picture shown on the word's card once it is found (assets/images/words/<picture>.png); none if it has no picture.
